title: Microsoft Copilot: memory personalises responses in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote and Workspaces
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, memory safeguards and Graph control match Microsoft's published text. It distinguishes general Copilot memory documentation from the still-undocumented Office-app rollout. Minor corrections are needed because the checklist names eDiscovery, Customer Lockbox and user settings that have no controls-table rows.
